dialogues.speaker: Aberdeen
dialogues.text: If I can just avoid the Forest Rangers...

dialogues.speaker: Aberdeen
dialogues.text: As an adventurer, the greatest plan is of course to travel every inch of the world and explore every secret this world has to offer!

dialogues.speaker: Aberdeen
dialogues.text: So, based on this goal of mine, I've decided to conquer Avidya Forest first!

dialogues.speaker: Aberdeen
dialogues.text: Bye! Maybe our next meeting will be in somewhere else!

dialogues.speaker: Aberdeen
dialogues.text: Ahem, what? I admit that I'm a novice, but every novice has to take their first step, right?

dialogues.speaker: Aberdeen
dialogues.text: I heard cute Fungi live in the rainforest, and there are tiny forest cats and mysterious treasures...

dialogues.speaker: Aberdeen
dialogues.text: The only obstacle between me and my grand adventure is those annoying Forest Rangers. If I can just avoid them, then I can...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hope you drop that thought...

dialogues.speaker: Aberdeen
dialogues.text: If that's your thought, you are not exactly "adventurous."

dialogues.speaker: Aberdeen
dialogues.text: Listen, to be the greatest adventurer, you must be ambitious and ready to take risks.
